column5: The sole raw unary worker races every dispatched command against the exact request-owned monotonic cancellation carrier and preserves timeout and remote-Canceled as distinct transport facts. Async SendRequest, batch, stream, forwarding, compression, TLS, metrics, resource control, and the broader command switch remain external.

Execution close, response close, pre-dispatch checks, in-flight unary dispatch, and post-RPC precedence share one request-owned cancellation carrier. The broader client-go RegionCache interface, async API, batch requests, and production concurrency remain external.
